menu_path_issues: Every RU string, including 'profiles.delete' (Удалить), was found verbatim in the RU docs (dashboard/profiles.md, popup/popup.md, dashboard/settings.md, dashboard/logs.md and others). The 'inferred' note on profiles.delete can be dropped.

All 11 menu paths match the docs. The only wrinkle is the System Proxy path, where the EN docs write 'Settings → Connection → System proxy' (lowercase p) and the Settings page heading is 'System Proxy'.

Source caveat: every label comes from bold text in the docs. Only the bold text in the docs backs the claim that the labels are the real UI strings. Popup items such as 'Pin popup' and 'Закрепить окно' could be tooltips or aria-labels, not visible text.

'nav.connections' is tagged state=connected, but the docs never say the page is empty or disabled while disconnected. They say only that it lists the 'current connections handled by the core'. Treat the 'connected only' tag as unverified.
'Dashboard' stays in English in the RU UI. The RU docs confirm this: 'Dashboard — открыть основное окно'.

The TUN doc says 'Profiles → card menu → Edit profile → Override', but the Profiles page names the section 'Overrides' (RU 'Переопределение'). The docs are inconsistent here. Do not cite the TUN-doc form.
The 'Update subscriptions' path is accurate. The single-profile update button has no documented text label (docs say only 'кнопка обновления на карточке'), and the table already says so.
The RU Connect path 'Значок в трее' omits the macOS wording. The docs say 'значок Flowvy в трее или строке меню'. On macOS, tell the user it is the menu bar icon.
missing_flows: Deep-link import: flowvy://import?url=<encoded subscription URL> (also flowvy://install-config, and flowvy-beta:// for Beta) opens the Add dialog. Source: integraciya/deep-links.md.
Popup with no profiles: a plus button opens the add-profile dialog.

Profile widget: Settings > Appearance > Profile widget (RU: Настройки > Интерфейс > Виджет профиля) replaces the mode selector with subscription status. It cannot be turned off if the provider enabled it.
Primary Group (RU: Основная группа), in Edit profile: picks the group used for the IP indicator in Rule mode. Changes need Save (RU: Сохранить).
Proxy port, in Settings > Connection (RU: Порт прокси): Automatic (RU: Автоматически) or Custom port (RU: Задать порт), then Apply (RU: Применить) or Cancel (RU: Отмена).
Connections on host change (RU: Соединения при смене хоста): Never / Changed group / All groups (RU: Не закрывать / Выбранной группы / Всех групп), plus Keep connections exclusions.

Helper service management: 'Uninstall service' (RU: Удалить службу) in Settings > Connection. macOS approval: Open System Settings, then General > Login Items & Extensions (RU: Основные > Объекты входа и расширения). The table covers the macOS approval only as a platform note.
Connections page actions: Close All / Close found (RU: Закрыть все / Закрыть найденные), the '+' button to create a rule, and Back (RU: Назад).

Profile overrides: Edit profile > Overrides > Override provider settings (RU: Редактировать > Переопределение > Переопределить настройки провайдера). Covers Log Level, TUN Stack, Parallel TCP, Unified Delay and Process Matching. Also Edit Rules / Edit Config (RU: Изменить правила / Изменить конфиг).

Other Settings > Appearance and Startup items: Theme (Тема), Window size, Tray icon background (macOS: Menu bar icon background), Launch at login (Запуск при входе), Launch without a window (Запуск без окна).
About page: Check, Install, Later (RU: Проверить, Установить, Позже) for client updates, plus Auto-check updates and Geo databases. Source: dashboard/about.md.
Settings > Tools > TUN bypass (RU: Обход TUN) and VLESS converter (RU: Конвертер VLESS).
Logs level filters DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR, Search (RU: Поиск), Auto-scroll (RU: Автопрокрутка), Expand/Collapse all rows (RU: Развернуть/Свернуть все строки).

Share link: no share-link or export feature is documented anywhere in the docs I read (popup, profiles, settings, tools, about, deep-links, llms.txt index). It is likely absent and should not be written into instructions. The only 'import from file' in the docs is for TUN-bypass address lists, not subscriptions.
caveats: Flowvy desktop is proprietary: github.com/flowvy/desktop holds only README, assets and releases. No source or locale files exist, so nothing was grepped for key usage; all labels come from official docs (docs.flowvy.io, EN under /home/en/, RU at root), not from the app binary. The key field is a synthetic name, not a real i18n key.
Latest stable release is 0.3.5 (2026-08-27). Betas 1.0.0-beta.7 to beta.9 (Sep-Oct 2026) are newer prereleases, and the UI may differ from the docs.
ru_locale_present=true is based on docs (Settings > Appearance > Language: Russian or English) and fully Russian docs; no locale file was inspected.

No documented share/copy subscription link or QR feature, no add by QR/file/clipboard button, and no cumulative traffic counter beyond speed in Popup and DL/UL data volumes in Connections. Do not name such buttons.
No fixed 'Connected'/'Disconnected' status text or timer is documented; only the Connect/Disconnect button text and the speed/IP display while connected.
Per-host latency icon (lightning), single-profile update button and plus button in Popup have no documented text label.
Docs are not pinned to tag 0.3.5 and may describe newer behavior. RU for Delete is unverified. The RU mode names, Profiles and Settings labels come from the RU docs pages.

Platform differences: desktop only (Windows, macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Linux Debian/Ubuntu x64). On macOS the tray is the menu bar; 'Tray icon background' is called 'Menu bar icon background' there, and 'DNS system' (Settings > Connection) is macOS only. No mobile client.
